market_outlook.short_term: Markets face a risk-off regime driven by Iran conflict (oil $101+), US-Canada trade war, and bond yield volatility. Tech/AI names provide relative strength. Expect elevated VIX, gold bid, and energy outperformance. ECB hike and Micron earnings (Sept 30) are key near-term catalysts. Stocks may consolidate after Labor Day gains.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle remains structurally intact (Palantir, Broadcom, Snowflake, Anthropic IPO). However, persistent oil inflation and trade fragmentation could force central banks to maintain restrictive policy longer. Gold above $4,400 signals structural de-dollarization trend. EM divergence (China vs. US yields) will drive capital flows. Consumer squeeze may persist through 2027.
